Preserve their recognizable identities: Vlanche is a Filipina around 40 with short softly wavy black hair, teal polo and dark trousers; midwife has tied-back black hair and light blue scrubs; elderly Filipino Ernesto has gray hair and a cream collared shirt. Vlanche thoughtfully arranges THREE blank cream note cards, midwife calmly contributes with one open hand, Ernesto listens and asks a question. Natural anatomically correct hands, relaxed respectful expressions, warm daylight, lived-in Philippine surroundings. Frame all three faces and the table clearly with comfortable margin, landscape composition suited to contained mobile and desktop display. No readable text, no personal information, no logos, no official-looking forms or campaign material, no medical procedure, no benefit promise. Keep the reference's natural photographic warmth and skin tones, but use a distinct composition and planning action; do not recreate the primary-care encounter.

beats.text: Sino po ang tatanungin ko? tanong ni Mang Ernesto. Magkaiba ang sagot na narinig ni Vlanche sa dalawang pagbisita. Itinala niya ang tanong, hindi ang pangalan.
Mungkahi ni Vlanche: isang maikling mensahe sa nakatakdang pagbisita sa susunod na linggo. Panukala pa lamang ito; kailangan munang pag-usapan at tiyakin.
Tinanong niya ang midwife tungkol sa kasalukuyang contact, mensahe at patakaran. Nakinig siya. Hindi niya ipapakalat ang hindi kumpirmado o babaguhin ang serbisyo nang mag-isa.
Sa halimbawa, nakumpirma ang mensahe at napagkasunduan ang plano. Si Vlanche ang gagamit ng sinuring gabay sa kanyang pagbisita. Kayang oras at gamit lamang. Babalikan sa Biyernes.

Pagkatapos magpaliwanag, itatanong niya kung sino ang lalapitan. Itatala ang bilang ng nakasagot at natitirang tanong, walang personal na detalye. Maliit na palatandaan ito, hindi garantisadong epekto.
Sa Biyernes, babalikan nila ng midwife ang feedback at aayusin ang mensahe kung kailangan. Napansin, tiniyak at napag-usapan, maliit na plano, sinubukan at binalikan. Ano ang iyong unang hakbang?

beats.text: Who should I ask? says Mang Ernesto. Vlanche heard different answers on two visits. She notes the question without names, and avoids blaming anyone.
Vlanche proposes one short message during scheduled visits next week. It is still a proposal: discuss it and confirm the information before using it.
She asks the midwife about the current contact, message and policy, and listens. She holds back unconfirmed information and does not change services on her own.
In the example, the message is confirmed and the plan agreed. Vlanche uses the checked guide during her visits, with feasible time and materials. They will review on Friday.
After explaining, she asks whom people would approach. She notes how many can answer and what questions remain, without personal details. This is a small indicator, not guaranteed impact.
On Friday, she and the midwife review feedback and revise the message if needed. Observe, confirm and discuss, make a small plan, try and review. What is your first step?
